en: Maki, did you check the rooftop?

No one was on the roof. I tried calling for
him, but there was no answer.
He probably...logged out first by himself.

But don't worry... He's stupid enough to get
himself killed, but I know he won't really die.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose that's true.
I don't have to worry about him...
<CLT=cltMIND>I have to hurry and log out.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm worried about Miu!
I need to log out!
